HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #10
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Religious Influences: Morals, values, social connections, daily habits, and over? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Religious Influences: Morals, values, social connections, daily habits, and over.
   B. Use Religious Influences: Morals, values, social connections, daily habits, and over to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Religious Influences: Morals, values, social connections, daily habits, and over has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Religious Influences: Morals, values, social connections, daily habits, and over with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Concepts of Paramatma Sanatan/Vedic ● Symbolism of OM ● Sound of OM ● Creation ●? (1 mark)

   C. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
